reviews.text: From the second we met Jose we could tell he was knowledgeable and easy to work with. We hired him to do a pretty big project which included re-siding our home, replacing windows, gutting and rebuilding a large section of our house, replacing doors, gutting and reno of a bathroom, and more. We are very happy with the quality of the work and how easy it was to communicate with Jose and his team.  Special shout out to Reni snd Dougie who did great carpentry and painting/finishes to our home. Will definitely use them for future projects!

Jose Galindo and his team did a wonderful job transforming our home from “grandmas” house to our dream home. After my wife and I closed on our first home we were a little overwhelmed after we noticed all the scratched floors, outdated paint and overall dated appearance after the sellers moved out. I had quite a few quotes from multiple contractors and chose Jose as he could do everything we were looking to have done at a midpoint, reasonable price.  Jose and his team were always punctual, friendly, and offered personal advice on what we should concentrate on with our first home reno. Jose also impressed me with his knowledge and problem solving for little bumps during the project. I cannot recommend him enough and my wife and I will continue using him and his team for future projects. PS Jose’s recommendation for a wood reflooring company was also excellent! The before and after pictures will speak volumes. Thank you Jose and team!

We hired Galindo’s Home Improvement to completely gut and remodel two bathrooms in our home, and they did A FANTASTIC JOB! Jose was very attentive, always checking in and providing updates. He used his creativity and expertise to give us exactly what we envisioned, coming up with solutions to any issues that arose. His workers are all highly skilled professionals (shout out to Nelson!), with great attention to detail. They left the house swept clean each day, with little interruption to our schedules. Pricing and invoicing was upfront, transparent and very reasonable. There are a lot of contractor choices in Huntington and Long Island, but we will only be using Galindo’s Home Improvement for any future projects!
